_about: English keys awaiting translation into the 19 enabled non-English catalogs (Playbook 132.4 handoff). Written by tools/localization_handoff.py; read by tools/validate_localization.py.

KEEP_LINE_ALL_UPGRADES.en: Every upgrade you bought, with Coins or Gems (a camp's own upgrades work again once you buy that camp again)

KEEP_LINE_MERGES.en: Merge levels of every weapon, outfit and skill, restored when you find that item again

KEEP_LINE_MAIN_OBJECTIVES.en: Main objectives you completed but have not claimed yet

RESET_LINE_CARRIED_ITEMS.en: Every item you carry (weapons, outfits, skills and supplies) and its random bonus attributes

RESET_LINE_RUN_PROGRESS.en: Unfinished opportunities and missions. Finished missions and unclaimed offline Coins and Gems are paid first; unclaimed offline item copies are lost

PRESTIGE_KEEP_ALL.en: Cards and sets, your Coins and Gems, every upgrade you bought with Coins or Gems, the merge level of every weapon, outfit and skill, explored map areas, player level and XP, boss keys, enemy achievements, Map Mastery, unclaimed main objectives and settings.

PRESTIGE_RESET_RUN.en: Every item you carry (supplies included) and its random bonus attributes, Supply Mastery, map access (back to Winter I), owned camps, and unfinished opportunities and missions.

LEGACY_ITEM_EXPLAIN.en: An old-stat copy from before the weapon update. It keeps its power until your next Prestige, then leaves with your items. New copies of this weapon use the new stats and keep your merge level.

EVOLUTION_RULE.en: At ^%d, spend %d spare copies for one copy of the next-tier weapon (%d copies in all). This weapon keeps its merge level and one copy; the new weapon uses its own merge level. A target stack or empty slot is required.

FOLLOW_MASTERWORK_ANY_GEAR.en: Merge an outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100: best ^%d/^100

FOLLOW_MASTERWORK_TIER_GEAR.en: Merge a tier %d+ outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100: best ^%d/^100

FOLLOW_ARSENAL_SPLIT_T2.en: Tier 2+ weapons at ^20: %d/%d · tier 2+ outfits at ^50: %d/%d

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O1_RULE.en: Merge any outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O2_RULE.en: Merge a tier 2 or higher outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O3_RULE.en: Merge a tier 3 or higher outfit, skill or Obsidian weapon to ^100

CONTENT_ARSENAL_O1_RULE.en: Merge one weapon to ^20 and one outfit to ^50

CONTENT_ARSENAL_O2_RULE.en: Merge 3 different weapons to ^20 and 3 different outfits to ^50

CONTENT_ARSENAL_O3_RULE.en: Merge 3 different tier 2+ weapons to ^20 and 3 different tier 2+ outfits to ^50

MERGE_AT_CAP.en: This item is at its merge cap.

EVOLUTION_NEEDS_COPIES.en: Evolution needs the full merge level and enough spare copies.

AUTO_EVOLVE_BENEFIT.en: Evolves at ^20 with 10 spare copies (31 in all): %s

MAIN_HINT_9.en: Evolve a ^20 weapon that has 10 spare copies (item details, Evolve)

MASTERY_FORGE_RULE.en: Outfits from here to ^%s (boss outfits ^%s) and one weapon from here evolved (Spring maps: an Obsidian weapon from here at ^20).

ITEM_ENHANCED.en: Boss weapon: two bonus attributes added

ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_EXPLAIN.en: Boss-enhanced: your first copy of this weapon from a boss added two bonus attributes. Later boss copies count as normal copies. Bonus attributes reset at Prestige; merge levels stay.

ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_HINT.en: The first copy of this weapon you get from a boss adds two bonus attributes (once per run).

REROLL_ATTRIBUTE_CONFIRM.en: Spend %s gems to reroll %s? The new roll replaces this attribute, even if weaker. Your other attributes stay as they are.

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: On Winter II, in order, defeat 50 of each: Wolf Hood, Calico Cat Hood, Golden Crown, Reindeer Antlers, Santa Hat, Space Helmet

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O5_DESCRIPTION.en: On Summer II, in order, defeat 60 of each: Cowboy Bandana, Duck Swim Ring, Rainbow Clown, Red Cap Swimmer, Snorkeler, Straw Hat Swimmer

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O6_DESCRIPTION.en: On Autumn I, in order, defeat 120 of each: Black Cap, Mushroom Cap, Pumpkin Head

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O7_DESCRIPTION.en: On Autumn II, in order, defeat 100 of each: Horned Hood, Orange Screen Helmet, Television Head, Top Hat

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_O8_DESCRIPTION.en: On Spring II, in order, defeat 60 of each: Flower Crown, Green Cap, Pink Cap, Pink Flower Hood, Plain, Sprout

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 16 each of the Santa Hat, Reindeer Antlers and Space Helmet outfits (Winter II drops). Submit hands in 15 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O5_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 26 each of the Snorkeler, Red Cap Swimmer and Straw Hat Swimmer outfits (Summer II drops). Submit hands in 25 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O6_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 31 each of the Black Cap, Mushroom Cap and Pumpkin Head outfits (Autumn I drops). Submit hands in 30 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O7_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 31 each of the Television Head, Top Hat and Orange Screen Helmet outfits (Autumn II drops). Submit hands in 30 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_COLLECTION_O8_DESCRIPTION.en: Pick up 41 each of the Pink Cap, Plain and Sprout outfits (Spring II drops). Submit hands in 40 of each and you keep one

CONTENT_HUNTER_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeat the Bee and the Orange Tabby Cat (Spring I bosses) 10 times each

CONTENT_CHALLENGE_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeat the Red Panda (Spring II boss) without using any supply during the fight

CONTENT_TROPHY_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: After finding this, defeat the Bee, the Orange Tabby Cat (Spring I), the Red Panda and the Sunflower (Spring II) once each

CONTENT_REGIONAL_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: On Autumn I and Autumn II: explore 90% of each map, defeat all four bosses and unlock every camp

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_O4_DESCRIPTION.en: Merge an Obsidian weapon (Spring I and Spring II drops) to ^100

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: -4% damage taken for each normal enemy attacking you beyond the first (up to -20%)

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C5_DESCRIPTION.en: When you drop below 30% HP, heal 25% of your maximum HP (once every 90 s)

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C6_DESCRIPTION.en: Basic attacks also deal 30% damage to other enemies close to your target

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C7_DESCRIPTION.en: Enemies called into a group fight start attacking 0.5 s later

CONTENT_EXPEDITION_C8_DESCRIPTION.en: Out of combat away from camps, you recover HP three times as fast

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: Weapons and outfits dropped by normal enemies have a 10% chance to be 2 copies

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C5_DESCRIPTION.en: Evolution needs 8 spare copies instead of 10

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C7_DESCRIPTION.en: Rerolls cost 25% fewer gems and never return the same stat

CONTENT_COLLECTION_C8_DESCRIPTION.en: Boss bonus attributes roll in the upper half of their range

CONTENT_HUNTER_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: Boss skill warnings last 0.3 s longer and boss heals restore 25% less

CONTENT_TROPHY_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: Defeating a boss for the first time in a run rolls its loot twice

CONTENT_REGIONAL_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: +25% XP from normal enemies on maps before your furthest unlocked map

CONTENT_MASTERWORK_C4_DESCRIPTION.en: +15% stats gained from every Obsidian weapon merge

FOLLOW_MASTERWORK_OBSIDIAN.en: Merge an Obsidian weapon to ^100: best ^%d/^100
